title: euphorbia × paradoxa
intro: Euphorbia × paradoxa, commonly known as the "Medusa's Head" or "Devil's Backbone" due to its unique appearance, is a hybrid succulent plant. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Euphorbia × paradoxa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
